name: Discover Reviews Companies
runs_on: an Apify run of the Trustpilot reviews scraper (blackfalcondata/trustpilot-reviews-scraper, reviews mode; stars, topics and freshness are the task's own config). The scraper's run webhook fires the door, so the payload is this Rootflow's launch contract
launch_row: none: an intent Insert is fired by the scraper, not by a Hub row. The payload is the launch row and the same laws hold: a bad payload is refused with a Hub Automations row that says why, never a throw

launch_payload.play: the Hub Signals record id. It carries Client (which resolves the Clayroots base), Signal Type, Country and ICP
launch_payload.resource: the Apify run object; only defaultDatasetId is read, the reviews this run scraped

reads: the Hub Signals row (Name, Client, Signal Type, Country, ICP); the Clients row's Clayroots Base ID; the client base's table list; the Signals mirror row for this signal (matched on Name, exactly one or refused); the Apify dataset; the Signals links the qualified domains already hold on Companies; the DNC table (inside the helper)
creates: nothing of its own. The register's Companies columns and the Reviews group (Review Count, Review Latest, Review Link, Review Titles, Review Quotes, Review Replied, Trustpilot Rating, Trustpilot Reviews Total, Trustpilot URL) must already exist: it lands with allowNew false, so a base without the group is refused by the helper with nothing written
held_value: a signal never blanks what a landing door wrote: an empty payload value is omitted everywhere, an empty core value is omitted on a held row. Signals is unioned with the links the row already holds, Signal At and ICP Reason are re-stamped, the Review payload is the latest event. Domain Source lands as Signal on create only. No Tag: on a signal Insert the signal is the Signals link
providers: Apify (the run dataset), DiscoLike BizData (one call per qualified company, 4.5 s apart), DiscoLike validate/icp (one task for the list, BYOK). Every one continues on error, is counted, and is named on the run row; a dead provider is a logged skip, never a crash
logs: one Hub Automations row, upserted on Execution ID, Client attached, Status computed from the failures. Description carries the funnel: review rows in and companies grouped, hard-line drops by reason, companies already carrying this signal (dropped before any paid call), BizData matched / unknown / closed / errors, the ICP verdicts with every no's reason, rows formatted (new vs signalled again), the helper's created / updated / DNC / landed, the contacts hand-off, then the failures and the skips
handoff: Enrich Contacts (PLTNYqqoYfrt9ypd), once, not awaited, one item: {Client, Table 'Companies', View 'Not Sourced', Tag '', Domains: the domains this run landed}. Nothing else is passed
dedupe: a company whose Companies row already links this signal's mirror row is dropped before any paid call; a company in the base under another signal or under none passes and is signalled in place
